cohort: The study included 48 neonates with spina bifida who had undergone fetal spina bifida repair at the University (Children's) Hospital Zurich between 2017 and 2022, and had at least one respiratory polygraphy (RPG) evaluation during neonatal hospitalization.
finding: The spina bifida cohort exhibited findings of SDB with central apnea and hypopnea, with 45.8% detecting central SDB and prompting caffeine therapy, which significantly improved by 3 months of age.
